parent_v2.rule: G2 remains refuted regardless of v3 outcome; v3 is a new analyst-world sensitivity question

scientific_question: Which reachability and impossibility conclusions survive when the same latent ecological landscape is translated into traversability using different response-independent analyst rules?
ecological_worlds: reuse the exact 384 v2 ecological factor rows and deterministic base seeds without changing A, B, geographic neighbourhood, barrier draws, source rule or factor levels

analyst_worlds.rule: edge permitted when absolute environmental difference is <= the within-landscape 70th percentile of geographic-edge differences
edge permitted when absolute environmental difference is <= 0.5 in the latent generator's raw environmental units
analyst_worlds.interpretation: fixed ecological tolerance that does not rescale with landscape smoothness

analyst_worlds.rule: standardize the node environmental field by its landscape SD and permit an edge when absolute standardized difference is <= 1.0

outputs: per-target analyst-world status: reachable_in_all / contingent / unreachable_in_all
fraction of locally permissive targets contingent across analyst rules
barrier-density effect within each analyst rule
low-versus-high autocorrelation pathwise-blocked contrast within each analyst rule

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: At least one locally permissive source-target classification is contingent across the three analyst worlds.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if all three rules give identical reachability for every target in all 384 rows.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: Expanding from the frozen q70 analyst world to all three analyst worlds may gain possible targets and lose robust possible/impossible certificates, but may not create a new robust impossibility for a target that q70 allowed.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: Any violation is an implementation/theory failure.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: The sign of the low-minus-high autocorrelation contrast in pathwise-blocked fraction differs for at least two analyst rules.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if all three rules give the same contrast sign or zero-equivalent direction.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: For each analyst rule, pooled mean viable-unreachable fraction is larger at barrier density 0.35 than at 0.05.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if any analyst rule has a nonpositive high-minus-low barrier contrast.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: At least one non-source locally permissive target is reachable under all three analyst rules and at least one is unreachable under all three rules somewhere in the panel.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if either robust category is globally empty.

claim_boundary: The three analyst rules are declared sensitivity worlds, not claims that one is ecologically correct.
Rule disagreement is epistemic/analytical uncertainty, not biological stochasticity.
v3 does not reclassify the refuted v2 G2 hypothesis.
The absolute 0.5 and standardized 1.0 thresholds are frozen generic sensitivity scales, not fitted dispersal or niche parameters.
stop_rules: Do not change the three analyst rules after scoring.
Do not add a fourth rule to obtain sign disagreement.
Do not retune the absolute or standardized tolerances after scoring.
Do not drop a rule because it behaves poorly.
